text: Two traps. First, a narrower slit gives a wider central maximum, because w is two lambda D over a. Second, in single slit diffraction, a sine theta equals n lambda gives the dark fringes. In Young's experiment and the grating, the same looking formula gives the bright ones. Read carefully which you are using.
